target.title: fix(reply): use document cap for local media attachments
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #40880 for outbound reply media: local final-reply attachments now fall back to the document media cap instead of the 5 MiB media-store cap when no explicit `mediaMaxMb` is configured.

## Why

I hit this on a real Telegram reply with a generated PowerPoint file:

- `MEDIA:./tmp/izen_shooting/Annual_CIS_Conference_2026_RU.pptx`
- `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation`
- `23,456,667` bytes

The small PDF in the same reply delivered, but the `.pptx` surfaced `Media failed` and never reached Telegram `sendDocument`. Direct `sendDocument` for the same file succeeded, so the failure was in reply-media staging before the channel adapter.

## Change

- Use `maxBytesForKind("document")` as the default local reply-media staging cap.
- Preserve explicit channel/account/default `mediaMaxMb` overrides.
- Update the reply-media path tests to expect the 100 MiB document cap by default.

## Validation

```text
node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/reply-media-paths.test.ts
# 1 file passed, 22 tests passed
```
